title: Farah Citadel
geometryBasis: 69 mapped wall nodes, 68 tagged bastions, the tagged southeast entrance and two cleared September 2004 views of the portico.
sectionBasis: Mapped wall positions and the original elevation field control the plan. The weathered sections, surviving heights and portico placement are reasonable estimates.
limitations: The wall and bastion positions follow the named mapped circuit. The surfaces and top heights represent weathered 2004 ruins, with erosion, wall widths and gateway profile estimated.

The two cleared photographs record the portico and ruined attached wing. The model places them on the nearby rising ground from the approximate common photo position. Portico scale, placement and rear construction are estimated.

Original independent elevations are preserved. The model covers the visible fortified perimeter and photographed portico. Exact subsurface features and lost interior structures remain outside the reconstruction.
